name: Angelic Wings
description: Radiant white feathers with a golden crest and a halo on top.

name: Bone Dragon Wings
description: The bare bones of a dragon's wings, claws tipped with a sickly green glow.

name: Cobweb Wings
description: Tattered bat wings strung with cobwebs, their edges smouldering orange.

name: Frost Wings
description: Wings of living ice - crystal shards over a frozen frame.

name: Phoenix Wings
description: Blazing feathers in every shade of fire, reborn with every stroke.

name: Raven Wings
description: Midnight-black feathers with a quiet blue sheen.

name: Shadowfang Wings
description: Leathery dragon wings with glowing violet claws.

name: Wraith Wings
description: A wraith's shroud torn into wings - violet wisps that trail behind you.
